settings.input_tokens_counted_by: the engine-reported usage.prompt_tokens, which includes the chat template
settings.prefill_seconds_definition: client time from dispatch to the first output chunk; it includes queueing, transfer, and the first sampled token
settings.decode_definition: usage.completion_tokens minus 1 divided by the time from the first to the last output chunk; it applies only while chunks are at least 0.9 per token
settings.aggregate_output_definition: output tokens of all requests in a closed-loop batch divided by the time from the first dispatch to the last completion, including ramp-up and ramp-down
settings.cache_policy_applied: a unique nonce starts every session; reported cached tokens must be zero except on warm agent turns, which must reuse at least 0.9 of the shared prefix
settings.peak_memory_definition: resident set size of PID 85646 sampled every 0.5 seconds during the formal passes; it may not include GPU memory

per_request_evidence.description: Per-request timings, token counts, and gate outcomes; it holds no prompts or model output
per_request_evidence.access_limitation: Kept next to the result document and not committed to the repository.
